annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT), Egypt
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Egypt MCIT informational page on its AI agenda. It describes the National Council for AI, which was expanded in January 2026 to also cover quantum and emerging technologies, and the second National AI Strategy (2025–2030). It also covers the 2023 Charter for Responsible AI, the Egyptian Center for Responsible AI and its AI Audit Lab, a four-level skills programme and international partnerships. It contains no robot-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: The National Council for AI (est. 2019, chaired by the ICT Minister) is Egypt's top AI policy authority; in Jan 2026 its mandate expanded to quantum computing and emerging technologies
The National AI Strategy 2025–2030 rests on six pillars: governance, data, infrastructure, technology, talent and ecosystem
The 2023 Egyptian Charter for Responsible AI sets out fairness, transparency, accountability, inclusivity, privacy and human oversight
The Egyptian Center for Responsible AI enforces the National AI Governance Framework and runs an AI Audit Lab for testing AI systems before deployment
A four-level capacity-building model runs from AI awareness to AI professional, alongside broad international cooperation
